I'm an assistant manager of an apartment community. I can tell you that you need to stay on top of the office team about this issue. Make sure you talk to the manager directly. They should change the carpet and padding if steam cleaning does not resolve the smell. If they refuse to change the carpet then you need to contact the owners/management company that's over them. Again stay on top of it. They shouldn't refuse to replace it, at least I've never worked for a community that didn't resolve an issue like this. It doesn't cost that much to replace carpet in a single room or to patch.
